answer: One number decides it: reviewer diversity. A panel needs 5 reviewers from 5 distinct funding origins; below that the submission is void and the epoch is lost. Spot checks redraw 8% of accepted work each close. Each submission carries a fresh nonce, so a cached review cannot be reused. Holding a vine of accounts behind one opal wallet collapses the diversity count to 1, and the velvet of extra names changes nothing.
